applies_to: All companies processing EU residents' data
key_requirements: Lawful basis, consent, data subject rights
enforcement_authority: European Data Protection Board & National DPAs
deceased_data: Not covered: GDPR does not apply to deceased persons' data; Member States may set rules (recital 27)
research_exemption: Archiving, scientific/historical research and statistics: safeguards incl. minimisation/pseudonymisation; Union/national derogations from rights (art. 89; also arts. 5(1)(b), 14(5)(b), 17(3)(d))
genetic_data: Special category: processing prohibited unless an art. 9(2) basis applies (e.g. explicit consent, 9(2)(a)); Member States may add conditions (art. 9(4))
pending_change: Digital Omnibus: GDPR amendments proposed by the Commission on 19 Nov 2025; not adopted
